name: upload_profile_media
description: Upload an image (base64) to the caller's own 21st.dev media storage and get back a first-party url to use as an `image` block's `mediaUrl` in edit_profile. Accepts png/jpeg/gif/webp up to 5 MB as a base64 data: url (`data:image/png;base64,...`) - NOT a remote url to fetch; download the bytes yourself and pass them as base64.

dataUrl.description: A base64 data: url, e.g. data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0...
